answer: In this PoA network, reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence persists only through sustained honest service. EigenTrust matrix factorization, adjusted for reciprocity-weighted transitivity, gives newly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality: they lack trusted paths and reciprocal history, and therefore cannot pass consensus merely by multiplying identities. A mesa of fabricated accounts, however crystal-clear their claims, cannot grow the vine of trust without time and verified exchanges.
